context:
Create a `_rolling_average_impl(ctx, sales_table, date_sk_col, item_sk_col,
sales_price_col, channel_table, channel_join_key_left, channel_join_key_right,
channel_cols, year)` helper function. Q47 and Q57 each become a ~5-line
call site passing their channel-specific parameters.
description:
Group 19 from the duplicate-check report identifies that q47_pandas_impl and
q57_pandas_impl in benchbox/core/tpcds/dataframe_queries/queries.py (~87 lines
each) implement the same rolling average algorithm. The differences are:
- Sales table: store_sales vs catalog_sales
- Column prefixes: ss_ vs cs_
- Channel dimension: store (s_store_sk/s_store_name/s_company_name)
  vs call_center (cc_call_center_sk/cc_name)
- Groupby keys: 4-key with company_name vs 3-key without

The TPC-DS specification intentionally mirrors Q47 and Q57 with the
store/catalog channel substitution. A parameterized helper is appropriate
since the algorithm is identical.

Note: Lower priority because this is within TPC-DS spec-conforming query code
where readability and auditability against the spec matters. The expression
implementations (Q33/Q60) are left as boilerplate for spec compliance reasons.

preserves.behavior: Q47 and Q57 produce identical query results to current implementations
